d:
You finally start moving on… and life really said “lol, let’s test that.”
Just when she’s getting her life together, guess who pops back in? Yep. *That* ex.
This FilterCopy Sketch dives into the chaos of moving on, and the feelings of longing that hits you out of nowhere when you thought you were finally okay.
Like… can you ever actually move on from someone you once loved? Or does closure only come when they randomly re-enter your life and mess with your peace again?
